# Doom Pi Major Mode

Named major-mode selection for Doom Pi sessions.

## How to author

- [Author DoomPi major modes](./src/prompts/doompi-author-major-mode/SKILL.md): Edit `modes.yaml` safely.
- [`modes.yaml` authoring contract](./src/prompts/doompi-author-major-mode/references/modes-contract.md): Source precedence, schema, resolution, and verification details.

## Package reference

- [Package README](./README.md): The `/mode` command, the `major_mode` voice tool, and how a mode resolves to layers.
